title: Dattatreya
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW richly detailed devotional reader illustration for the Vedansh app. EXACT 2:1 horizontal landscape canvas, e.g. 1774x887 or 1920x960.
Input roles: Image 1 is the existing subject/motif reference, showing the content to retain; its muted background rendering and square/portrait dimensions are NOT the target. Images 2 and 3 are approved Krishna storybook STYLE ONLY references. Image 4 is an approved detailed Style 3 landscape sample; match its detailed hand-painted finish and short horizontal format, not its characters or setting.
Rendering: elegant fine warm-brown outlines, graceful expressive faces, muted yet legible pastel colours, soft layered painterly shading, detailed cloth and ornaments, matte gold, subtle warm paper grain. Retain rich narrative and environmental detail: architecture, vegetation, meaningful props, jewellery, fabrics and layered backgrounds. Do not simplify or remove detail merely for the storybook style. Preserve tonal separation, clarity and depth without photographic gloss or a heavy sepia wash.
Composition: Draw a complete new landscape arrangement appropriate to the subject. Recompose the reference sideways instead of cropping, stretching or shrinking its portrait/square canvas. Every meaningful subject, crown, face, connected hand/arm/leg, foot, vahana and key prop must fit fully inside a comfortable 6 percent inner margin. Keep animals' complete bodies, hooves/paws/tails, long instruments/spears, relevant wheels and full shrine arches visible. The 2:1 canvas is painted edge to edge, with at most a very narrow paper fade; no large blank caption band. Dignified devotional proportions, not caricature or chibi.
Constraints: exact specified counts of figures, limbs and objects; coherent connected anatomy, no duplicate/disconnected hands or attributes. No new in-image text, letters, pseudo-script, captions, labels, UI, frame, border or watermark. Use the scene's own setting, never import the Krishna style-reference river/cottage/characters into unrelated scenes. No modern items, arbitrary additional main characters, gore or violent injuries.
Scene: Dattatreya in his traditional three-headed, six-armed form stands serenely under a broad sacred tree. Show his complete figure, the cow behind him and four small dogs gathered around his feet. Entire crowns, heads, hands, attributes, feet and animals visible. The animals form a horizontal arrangement in a peaceful pastoral landscape. Preserve image 1's three serene heads and exactly six arms: discus, conch, mala on one side and trishul, damaru, water pot on the other. Exactly one cow and four distinct complete dogs. Include detailed banyan roots/leaves, a small hut and pastoral landscape.
